steps.content: Silver light descends, cutting through every thread.
The dancer in the sky cries out, drifting down and sprawling on the ground.
Losing control, the actors collapsed limply into a heap, their eyes devoid of light and seemingly no longer capable of sparking hope.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Yes... this is your doing... your decision...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Embrace the script, be one with it...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: This is... this is... your stage!
You approach the dancer with measured steps, your strength overwhelming it. Yet, in the face of overpowering suppression, it slowly lifts its hand.
Rising up, it seeks to reach your heart with a mere touch of its fingertips.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Goodbye, you'll never have control over me.
The blade's silvery light pierces the flower's core.
Crimson petals take flight, creating a breathtaking scene like a wind gust moving through a sea of flowers.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Ah... I adore... the look in your eyes...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: It's... the pure desire, so pure it's as though there's nothing inside your heart...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've always been this way.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: No... true greed... is having nothing at all...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can't control me.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: I've lost my control over everyone... you've bested me... you're everyone's hero.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm... a hero?

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Yes... It's your time to shine...
Suddenly, the lights flash, and a wave of cheers engulfs the scene.
Everyone's praising you, complimenting your magnificent outfit, idolizing your expert swordplay, longing for your power which you never realized you possessed.
And in this noisy gloom, Lady Pearl's voice, clear and soft, reaches your ears.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Amazing... absolutely fantastic...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You are the performer I've always longed for... ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Stay with me, and I'll turn you into a star.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You have endless choices, each leading to a different life... any life you wish for...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'll go on with the act.

steps.content: The dancer on the ground begins to fracture and reassemble, morphing into your image.
It's as if gazing into a mirror.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since I've become the hero of this place... I'll keep going.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll be the one to shield everyone, freeing them from control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My silver sword will cut through all unease, severing...
Severing what?
In the blur, something warm is steadily approaching.
Your hand holding up the sword begins to go out of control, sinking downward bit by bit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's going on... why is this sword getting so heavy...
Ignis... maybe Chief needs a jolt, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I don't think it's a good idea...
In the blink of an eye, all the echoes in your head are gone. With your sword dropping to the ground, you suddenly come to your senses.
In front of you, Ignis and Luvia Ray are frowning, gazing at you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What... what's going on with me?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: That's my question to you. We found ourselves on this stage as soon as we woke up.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Right, then we saw you dressed in these clothes, alone on stage, lost in a solo performance.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You were swinging this sword around, delivering some really melodramatic lines...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's just forget about this part, please.
Those who were sprawled out on the stage are slowly waking up, looking as if they've just snapped out of a dream.
As they came to, the crowd burst into rounds of applause.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Wow, it's crazy! The quality of this show is unbelievable!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: That was incredibly realistic!!! And I remember all the details!!!
They're chatting and leaving the stage, still making fun of you.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Hey dude, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!
steps.female_content: Hey missy, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!

steps.content: While you're chatting, a smooth saxophone melody begins to fill the air.
That iconic saxophone melody plays, like a homeward path for wanderers, guiding you, your team, and the audience, towards the rear exit of Fortuna Theater.
However, in the crowd, some audience members linger, reluctant to leave, kneeling beside the gown of the dancer who fell on the stage.
Crying and shouting, they reach out to grasp the lives they picked in the play.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: No... I don't want to go!!

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: That's the life I want... that's my dream!!
The red lips on the gown's edge seem to respond, slowly opening, mercilessly devouring all those people.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What?!

The dazzling dancer gracefully gets back on her feet, her eyes locking with yours. She stands there, elegant as ever, a spitting image of the noble lady in the crowd, who is watching you with keen interest.
Caught in the thick of the crowd, there's no going back now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll be back, you won't get away.
As though she caught your words, the noble lady, owner of the theater, gives you a smiling wave.
The doors grind shut, sealed for good.
The Fortuna Theater, bustling with shows, again falls into quietude, anticipating the next visitor to lose themselves in its plays.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna Theater appreciates your visit, and we look forward to our next encounter, perhaps in a more profound realm of desires.
You set aside your silver sword and face the audience, giving a respectful nod to the person in the central seat.
Out of nowhere, a round of applause breaks out, celebrating your stunning performance.
As the clapping continues, the ghostly images on stage slowly dissolve, bringing everything into sharper focus.
Light filters in from somewhere, soft like the first hints of dawn.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Huh...? It feels like... I had an incredibly long dream...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I feel the same... That dream... it was incredibly vivid...
As Ignis and Luvia Ray come to, they recognize you and dash over, their faces lighting up with joy and astonishment.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Hey Chief, guess what? I had this dream! I was the star of a musical!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: But you vanished, and I was running around looking for you. I really wanted you to be the first one to see me shine in the lead role...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I looked everywhere but just couldn't find you. When I woke up... what a relief, you were the first person I saw!
Ignis, fiddling with her hair, murmurs in agreement.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Me too... And I baked an apple pie and was hoping you'd try it in my dream...
Ignis suddenly turned her head away, eyes looking elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: When we get back to the Bureau, I want to take a crack at making it.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: But you've got to watch me by my side, that way you'll be the first to know how it turns out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I promise, I'll be there for your debut as the leading lady and be the first to try the dish you whip up.
You breathe a sigh of relief and give them both a reassuring pat on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Wait, why am I lying down here?
Not only you two, but those who were sprawled out on stage are also coming to, looking as bewildered as if they've just woken from a dream.
When reality sets back in, they break into waves of applause.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Wow, it's crazy! The quality of this show is unbelievable!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: That was incredibly realistic!!! And I remember all the details!!!
They're chatting and leaving the stage, still making fun of you.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Hey dude, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!
steps.female_content: Hey missy, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!

steps.content: You give an awkward wave, planning to slip backstage and get out of this outfit. But then, you see the aerial dancer slowly vanishing into thin air.
And there, in the place it faded away, is someone you've never laid eyes on before.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are...?
The outfit she has on isn't for show; it's the same kind of everyday wear you guys have on.
Digging into her pocket, you pull out a promotional flyer.

steps.speaker: Flyer
steps.content: Fortuna: A Winter's Welcome in the Year N.F. 113.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She was in the audience last year?!
It hits you out of the blue. As you're about to dig further, the air fills with the soothing strains of a saxophone melody.
That iconic saxophone melody plays, like a homeward path for wanderers, guiding you, your team, and the audience, towards the rear exit of Fortuna Theater.
But in the throng, some audience members linger, sprawled out on the stage.
Crying and shouting, they reach out to grasp the lives they picked in the play.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: No... I don't want to go!!

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: That's the life I want... that's my dream!!
Caught in the moment, with no time to scrutinize or think deeply, you're swept along by the crowd. Unable to turn back, your only option is a fleeting look back at the dimly lit seats.
There, in the heart of the seats, stands the lady with charming curls, the theater's owner, beaming as she waves to you.
The doors grind shut, sealed for good.
The Fortuna Theater, bustling with shows, again falls into quietude, anticipating the next visitor to lose themselves in its plays.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna Theater appreciates your visit, and we look forward to our next encounter, perhaps in a more profound realm of desires.
